notes: ARD section 15 fields vs the FRI-T1 shape: ggen_igniter's SemanticJira.machine_experience/1 manufactures (subject, work_order_digest, execution_receipt_hash, observation_refs, verification_digest, resulting_state_digest, replay_identity, standing CANDIDATE, authority NONE, experience_digest), and sj:MachineExperienceShape is sh:closed over exactly those. The ARD section 15 fields (problem_class ... source_episode) therefore ride on a linked xme:AdmittedExperience node (xme: = https://xaas.dev/ontology/machine-experience#), not on the sj:MachineExperience node; the shape judges the sj: node (focus_node_count 1) and the router requires both. The ME's sj:standing stays CANDIDATE as the shape demands; admission is the xme:admission ADMITTED fact written only after the xaas gate and the SHACL court pass.

The applicability predicate is a SPARQL SELECT over the order's RDF rendering (xme:failureClass, sj:repository, sj:consequenceClass, sj:authorityCeiling, no sj:requiresCapability), evaluated by SPARQL.ex in the router and independently by rdflib in the court over me-2/order.ttl.

The runner now sorts the refs and admit/4 refuses unsorted ones. New receipt heads are pinned under new create-only refs; nothing earlier was moved or deleted (history 14116b1; refs bd84b3e, 48ae4ad).

Scope of the digests (stated in the moduledoc): recomputation detects any edit made without recomputing the digests; a writer who recomputes them forges a self-consistent node -- content addressing, not authority. Authority stays with BRCE, leases and receipts; the GC23-9 court's python-resealed falsifier is exactly such a self-consistent node, and it still cannot route KNOWN with an unevaluable predicate.
